text: **It names the checks.** Given a session in a repo whose spec names the checks unit and e2e, when the session calls `deep_status`, then the reply lists both names. Today the reply has no such field.

**It names the session's open asks.** Given a session with one open taste ask, when it calls `deep_status`, then the reply holds that ask's handle, its state, its default and when it takes it. Today the reply has no such field.
**It names the session's open items.** Given a session that recorded an open item, when it calls `deep_status`, then the reply holds the item's text. Today the reply has no such field.
**Nothing of another session.** Given two sessions with an ask each, when one calls `deep_status`, then the other's ask is not in the reply. A planted status that lists every session's asks fails.
**#26's budget holds.** On the reference Mac, with 30 days in the record, `deep_status` still answers under 100 ms at p95.
